title: Color contrast and readable text
description: Calculate WCAG 2.2 sRGB relative luminance and contrast ratios, distinguish normal and large text thresholds, and test real foreground/background pairs.
objectives: Explain why text contrast affects visual readability
Implement luminance and WCAG contrast ratio for opaque hex colors
Distinguish 4.5:1 normal and 3:1 large text thresholds
Avoid overstating what a two-color calculator certifies
rubric: I calculated known test pairs with correct sRGB gamma correction.
I distinguished normal and large-text contrast thresholds.
I explained why a two-color checker does not certify the rest of a page.
